defs.def: a job or profession 工作；职业

ex.s: This requires commitment to a particular occupation, branch of study or research.
ex.t: 这需要对某一特定职业、学科或研究领域的投入。

defs.def: the way in which you spend your time, especially when you are not working 消遣；业余活动
the act of moving into a country, town, etc. and taking control of it using military force; the period of time during which a country, town, etc. is controlled in this way 侵占；占领；占领期

ex.s: Code-named “Operation Overlord”, it was the largest combined sea, air and land operation in history, the aim being to free north-west Europe from German occupation.
ex.t: 代号＂霸王行动＂，这是历史上最大规模的海陆空联合作战，目的是将西北欧从德国占领下解放出来。

defs.def: the act of living in or using a building, room, piece of land, etc. （土地、房屋、建筑等的）使用，居住，占用
